g.text: Notes
Cut through the shaft axis along the base building's long axis (27.7 deg). The
section shows what is published as text (core type, mat, steel flare and cab,
TMDs); no structural drawing was found, so wall thicknesses, core diameter,
floor levels and the elevator / stair core are placeholders.
Outer profile as BT-02: family 1 (D 15.2, rim 67.36) dashed and detailed,
family 2 (D 14.5, rim 64.0) dash-dot; the spec trio (67.36 / 14.3 / 14.2) is
inconsistent and not drawn. The cab is drawn on its inferred centre, offset
1.8 m (1.5 E, 1.0 N) from the axis [inf], 1.6 m NNE in this cut. Dark plinth
ring D 10.8 m (F1) under the cab glass, from the flare deck to the sill [obs
photo t1].
